events.subject: Baseline qualifications
events.change: Male, age 21, British-subject privileges, literacy, six months residence and property qualifications; judges, magistrates, police and returning officers excluded.
events.locator: Electoral History, printed p.510, RL1871 no.156 summary
events.scope: British Columbia provincial franchise; not federal or municipal franchise

events.subject: Chinese and Indigenous people
events.change: The racial exclusions began in 1872, not 1874. The bill was reserved on 11 April; the 26 October proclamation signifies assent and says the Act is now in force. The assented version is SBC1872 no.37, distinct from the reserved no.39.
events.locator: 2025 errata p.3, corrections to printed pp.511,530,533; Gazette26October1872 printedp.2/PDFp.2
events.scope: British Columbia provincial franchise; not federal or municipal franchise
events.qualification: The Gazette does not state the date of the prior federal decision or reproduce the racial-exclusion clause; the official historical correction supplies the substantive category.

events.subject: Property and residence
events.change: Removes property qualifications and standardizes residence at twelve months in the Province and two months in the electoral district for otherwise eligible male British subjects aged21.
events.scope: British Columbia provincial franchise; not federal or municipal franchise

events.subject: Government officers and teachers
events.change: Extends occupational restrictions, including specified federal officers and government school teachers.
events.scope: British Columbia provincial franchise; not federal or municipal franchise

events.subject: Government employees
events.change: Repeals the April amendment and substitutes broader federal/provincial employment restrictions with specified exceptions; campaigning restrictions are a separate rule.
events.scope: British Columbia provincial franchise; not federal or municipal franchise

events.subject: Government employees; sheriffs
events.change: Repeals the 1878 occupational provisions identified in the Act, while explicitly retaining/adding sheriff and deputy-sheriff restrictions in the relevant class.
events.scope: British Columbia provincial franchise; not federal or municipal franchise

events.subject: Japanese people
events.change: Adds Japanese people to the racial disqualification.
events.scope: British Columbia provincial franchise; not federal or municipal franchise

events.subject: Residence; civil servants
events.change: Reduces residence from twelve to six months in the Province and from two to one month in the district; separately expands specified office/employment restrictions.
events.scope: British Columbia provincial franchise; not federal or municipal franchise
events.correction: Use the original 1899 Act for this change; do not assign it to the 1900 procedural amendment merely from a summary chronology.

events.subject: Literacy; judges, sheriffs and civil servants
events.change: Adds ability to read the Act in English, with grandfathering; s.5 repeals the 1899 s.3(2) category covering judges, sheriffs and civil servants.
events.scope: British Columbia provincial franchise; not federal or municipal franchise

events.subject: People classified by the statute as Hindu
events.change: Adds a racial category defined by Indian origin and parentage; the statutory term is not a reliable description of religious affiliation.
events.scope: British Columbia provincial franchise; not federal or municipal franchise

events.subject: Women
events.change: Removes the male-only restriction but leaves other qualifications and racial exclusions in place.
events.scope: British Columbia provincial franchise; not federal or municipal franchise

events.subject: Deserters; military-service-exempt groups; conscientious objectors
events.change: Creates disqualifications tied to desertion, the federal military-exemption orders of1873/1898/1899, and specified conscientious exemptions. Active-service and other exceptions are explicit.
events.locator: SBC1919 c.25, s.2 inserting s.7A(2)–(3), printed pp.107–108
events.scope: British Columbia provincial franchise; not federal or municipal franchise
events.warning: This is an early military-exemption restriction; it must not be collapsed into the distinct1931 extension to descendants.

events.subject: Literacy and veterans
events.change: The replacement Act omits the reading qualification and includes a wartime-service exception to the ordinary age requirement; military-exemption exclusions persist.
events.scope: British Columbia provincial franchise; not federal or municipal franchise

events.subject: Military-exempt communities and descendants
events.change: Extends the exemption-order category to people who could claim exemption on producing a certificate and every descendant, whether born in the Province or elsewhere.
events.scope: British Columbia provincial franchise; not federal or municipal franchise

events.subject: Japanese Canadian veterans
events.change: Creates an exception for Japanese people who served in Canada’s naval, military or air forces in the1914–1918war, subject to discharge-document requirements.
events.scope: British Columbia provincial franchise; not federal or municipal franchise

events.subject: Residents of the Provincial Home
events.change: Replacement Act removes the old institutional exclusion for aged/infirm Provincial Home inmates. Its commencement is deferred.
events.locator: SBC1939 c.16, qualification clauses and s.282
events.scope: British Columbia provincial franchise; not federal or municipal franchise

events.subject: Provincial Elections Act1939
events.change: The issued proclamation commences SBC1939c.16 and repeals RSBC1936c.84 on1April1940.
events.scope: British Columbia provincial franchise; not federal or municipal franchise

events.subject: Veterans of either World War; registration before21stbirthday
events.change: Section3 broadens the military-service exception to a person who served in Canada’s naval, military or air forces in1914–1918 or the present war. Section2 separately allows otherwise eligible people who will reach21before the poll to register.
events.scope: British Columbia provincial franchise; not federal or municipal franchise

events.subject: Chinese and South Asian people; residence; language; named religious communities
events.change: Removes Chinese and Hindu racial categories; retains Japanese/Indigenous exclusions with exceptions. Requires twelve months in Canada, six months in BC, district residence and adequate English/French; expressly names Doukhobor,Hutterite,Mennonite categories and exceptions.
events.scope: British Columbia provincial franchise; not federal or municipal franchise

events.subject: Mennonites and Hutterites
events.change: Removes Hutterite and Mennonite disqualifications, while retaining a narrower Doukhobor definition tied to the1898federal exemption order and descendants.
events.scope: British Columbia provincial franchise; not federal or municipal franchise

events.subject: Women married to eligible voters
events.change: Creates an overriding qualification for women married to eligible voters, subject to specified age, residence, British-subject and language requirements.
events.scope: British Columbia provincial franchise; not federal or municipal franchise

events.subject: Indigenous and Japanese people
events.change: Removes the remaining named Indigenous and Japanese racial exclusions from the provincial franchise.
events.scope: British Columbia provincial franchise; not federal or municipal franchise

events.subject: Voting age and Doukhobor disqualification
events.change: Reduces voting age21→19 and replaces the disqualification section without the Doukhobor prohibition; language and certain conviction restrictions remain.
events.locator: SBC1953 Second Session c.5, ss.3–4; RSBC1948c.1s.6
events.scope: British Columbia provincial franchise; not federal or municipal franchise
events.correction: 1953, not1952. Act has no deferred commencement; contemporaneous Interpretation Act supplies the assent default.

events.subject: Language qualification and married-woman exception
events.change: Repeals the special married-woman qualification and the English/French requirement in the specified amendments.
events.scope: British Columbia provincial franchise; not federal or municipal franchise

events.subject: Election Amendment Act,1984
events.change: Despite its1984short title, this isSBC1985c.5 and was assented to21February1985; commencement is deferred.

events.subject: Citizenship and court-ordered mental-health detention
events.change: OIC1648brings the Election Amendment Act,1984 into force, including Canadian-citizenship qualification and its mental-health detention amendment.
events.scope: British Columbia provincial franchise; not federal or municipal franchise
events.date_verification: Approval stamp AUG29; Council meeting AUG28 is a distinct date.

events.subject: Convicted people no longer imprisoned
events.change: The official Elections BC history records that convicted offenders no longer in prison could vote from1988. The original amendment and its exact operative day remain unverified here.

events.change: Replacement Election Act limits the prisoner disqualification to people serving sentences of at least two years, removes the former court-ordered mental-health-institution category, and expressly disqualifies the Chief and Deputy Chief Electoral Officers.
events.locator: SBC1995c.51ss.29–30 and327(4), PDFpp.28–29,283; Elections BC1995/96 annualreport transmittal andprintedpp.1,4

events.subject: Prisoners serving sentences of two years or more
events.change: Section30(b), the remaining sentence-length prisoner disqualification, is repealed by SBC2003c.37s.11.
events.locator: Point-in-time Election Act, s.30(b), effective29May2003; displayed pre-amendment text
events.scope: British Columbia provincial franchise; not federal or municipal franchise
events.qualification: This is the provincial statutory repeal date, not a claim about the earlier practical effect of Charter litigation.

events.subject: Current provincial electorate
events.change: Canadian citizens aged18by final voting day, six months BC residence, residence in the district, registration and no applicable disqualification. The Act provides residence rules for imprisoned and unhoused people.

events.warning: Current eligibility does not establish the dates each historical prisoner/mental-health restriction was removed.

critical_model_rules: People of British Columbia is broader than the electorate. Use a dated eligible-electors subset for the election edge.
Dates expressly marked royal_assent do not certify a separate proclamation or deposit. Where a commencement instrument is found it is a separate event.
The1917change did not enfranchise every woman; intersecting racial and other restrictions persisted.
A group restriction, a veteran exception, a spouse exception and descendant extension are separate events.
The1952/1953elections used alternative voting, not single transferable vote; see the2025errata.
Historical statutory racial terms are retained only where necessary to identify the legal category; they are not adopted as contemporary population labels.
remaining: Complete colonial pre1871qualification chain and property thresholds
Remaining early assent-only amendments should be checked against contemporaneous Interpretation Acts and any special commencement clauses before converting them to effective days
The1872federal assent-decision date is not stated in the recovered public proclamation; the earlier correspondence return remains a lead.
